CommunityApplications.Profile: Richard Skinner maintains unMotion: VM cloning, cold, warm and scoped live migration, CPU compatibility preparation, scheduled ZFS replication and guarded manual recovery for Unraid. Restricted pinned SSH, disposable live-transfer keys and native start fencing protect managed operations. Review inactive-copy cleanup and replica retirement in the web GUI. Live migration includes a handover pause; software-TPM support remains experimental. Automatic failover is not implemented. Read the setup and coordinated upgrade guide; use GitHub issues for help. Keep verified backups.
